description:
Upload an Android App Bundle and roll it out on a track in a single operation.

Set `action` to one of:
• run [write]: Upload an AAB and create/patch a release on the given track. — requires: packageName, track, media

editId.description: Open edit ID from play_edit.insert. If omitted, the change is applied in a fresh edit and committed automatically (when PLAY_AUTO_COMMIT_EDITS is on).

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file to upload.

mimeType.description: MIME type; inferred from the action if omitted.

rolloutFraction.description: user fraction for staged rollout (use with status inProgress/halted)

status.description: Release status. Use inProgress/halted with rolloutFraction for staged rollout.

track.description: Release track, e.g. production, beta, alpha, internal, or a form-factor track like wear:production.

validateOnly.description: validate the edit instead of committing

name: play_publish_release
title: Publish a release
